title: docs: fix typo builtin -> built-in in plugins guide
body:
Fixes minor docs typo for consistency:

- **builtin** → **built-in** in docs/plugins/index.md (heading and body text)
- Aligns with hyphenated form used elsewhere (e.g., migration guide uses built-in) and correct English hyphenation for adjective.
- Preserves URL https://rolldown.rs/builtin-plugins/ unchanged.

Minimal docs-only change, no functional impact.
